issues.detail: English keyword 'the' (article, <2) replaced by content noun '회사'. Korean has no article; substitution is defensible but changes the task, and '회사' also matches 자회사/회사원.
English prompt asks for 'at least one placeholder' but kwargs require 3. Korean says '최소 3개', matching kwargs, so the Korean item is consistent; the English source is the defective one.
Forbidden '어린이집' and '스토리텔링' miss spaced variants '어린이 집' and '스토리 텔링', so a violating answer can pass. Guideline rule 3 prefers a component stem for spaceable compounds.
Keyword '사용불가' fails if an answer uses standard spacing '사용 불가' or '사용 불가능'. Prompt quotes '사용불가', so a careful answer passes; a natural one may not.

prompt_to_repeat contains the forbidden words 경제, 수요, 공급, so repeating it verbatim fails forbidden_words under strict scoring. Same in English (economy/demand/supply). Loose passes by dropping line 1.
Forbidden stem '수요' also matches '수요일' (Wednesday), a false fail for an unrelated common word.
prompt_to_repeat contains a comma ('쉼표(,)'), so the required verbatim repeat fails no_comma under strict scoring. English also has one ('brackets, i.e.'). Loose passes by dropping line 1.
